Sync Master Excel

Edit questions in Excel, then review and confirm changes here. The database remains the saved record; Excel changes are not applied automatically.

Loading sync history…

1. Download the latest workbook

Start with a fresh download of Master_excel_YYMMDD_HHMM.xlsx (Bangkok date and time). It contains all questions, revision numbers and sync instructions. Older Excel exports cannot be synced safely; transfer your edits into this template.

2. Edit and upload

For linked questions, add a shared scenario on the Cases sheet using a unique Case ID (for example S001). On Questions, enter that Case ID and a unique Case order from 1 to 26. Leave both blank for standalone questions. Keep existing revisions unchanged; new cases use a blank revision. Removing a Cases row does not delete a case.

  • Keep existing Permanent IDs and Revision numbers unchanged.
  • For a new question, set Action to Add and leave ID and Revision blank. New questions start as Draft.
  • Use Archive to remove a question from new learner sessions while preserving past attempts. Removing a row does not delete it.
  • Use the detailed editor to upload images. Excel stores image paths.

3. Review and confirm

    Confirmation creates a verified backup, checks versions again, and saves all changes together. Existing attempts and scores stay unchanged.
